## Documentation and compatibility

- [ ] Linked requirement status accurately reflects implementation
- [ ] PRODUCT/ROADMAP/architecture/ADR updated if relevant
- [ ] No claim that planned features are already available
- [ ] Canonical model / migrations / content-loss risk reviewed if relevant
- [ ] No unrelated app behaviour or branding changes
- [ ] No secrets, customer documents, sensitive screenshots or unlicensed assets committed

## Review

- [ ] Changes are on a branch, not directly on main
- [ ] Reviewer can validate acceptance criteria
- [ ] Safe to merge only after review
